entities.summary: Ahmed Mourad Salah El-Din Zulfikar, was an Egyptian mechanical engineer and entrepreneur. He worked for three decades in the field of infrastructure. Zulfikar was one of the first founders of the modern irrigation systems technology in Egypt.
